title: Rising Heat
currentScenario: Pimpri-Chinchwad is experiencing rising temperatures and increasing heat stress, particularly in densely built-up areas with limited green cover.
plannedActions: Sponge Streets and Green Mobility Corridors
Nature-based urban forestry and green barriers
citizenActions: Use shaded and green public spaces responsibly
Follow heat-safety advisories during extreme heat

title: Flooding and Water Logging
currentScenario: Heavy rainfall can cause flooding and water logging in vulnerable areas of Pimpri-Chinchwad, affecting mobility, infrastructure and communities.
plannedActions: Create sponge areas for rainwater absorption
citizenActions: Keep drains and waterways free from waste
Avoid dumping waste in natural drainage channels
Follow local flood and heavy-rain advisories

title: Solid Waste Management
currentScenario: Pimpri-Chinchwad generates around 1400 tons of waste per day, with approximately 38% biodegradable waste and 35% plastic waste. Waste generation is expected to increase significantly in the future.

title: Green City and Biodiversity
currentScenario: Urban development and increasing temperatures are putting pressure on trees, green spaces and biodiversity across Pimpri-Chinchwad.
plannedActions: Protect and increase urban tree cover
citizenActions: Keep parks and green spaces clean

title: Sustainable Mobility
currentScenario: Pimpri-Chinchwad has more than 19 lakh two-wheelers and around 5.4 lakh cars, while the number of buses remains below 2000, creating challenges for sustainable urban mobility.
citizenActions: Walk or cycle for suitable short trips
Maintain vehicles properly to reduce emissions

title: Renewable and Efficient Energy
currentScenario: Buildings and energy use account for a major share of greenhouse gas emissions, while solar energy adoption remains an area with significant potential.
plannedActions: Install solar energy systems on PCMC buildings

title: Water Security and Conservation
currentScenario: Groundwater depletion and increasing water demand create challenges for long-term water security. Water conservation and efficient reuse are important for climate resilience.
citizenActions: Avoid polluting rivers and water bodies

title: Clean Air and Healthy Life
currentScenario: PM2.5 and PM10 levels in Pimpri-Chinchwad can exceed safe limits, creating air-quality challenges for residents.
plannedActions: Implement measures under the Graded Response Action Plan
Reduce major sources of air pollution
citizenActions: Prefer public and shared transport where practical
Support cleaner and less polluting practices
